note: Lengths are CSS px at 1x, colours #rrggbb. paper = dark ink on the survey print; aerial = white ink on the dimmed photograph. A variant lists only the tokens it changes.

tokens.name: color.union
tokens.doc: Union: the fill of a unit mark and of a formation standard.  Documented side.  White glyph on it is 7.0:1 (tested).

tokens.name: color.confederate
tokens.doc: Confederate: the fill of a unit mark and of a formation standard.  Documented side.  White glyph on it is 4.9:1 (tested).

tokens.name: color.unknown
tokens.doc: Contested side (10 ids whose state code contradicts the prefix): amber with a diagonal hatch, never a side colour.

tokens.name: color.unknownInk
tokens.doc: Ink of the glyph and of the count on the contested amber.

tokens.name: color.glyph
tokens.doc: Ink of the arm glyph, the bars and the count inside a fresh mark.

tokens.name: color.ringLight
tokens.doc: The light ring that separates a mark from any ground.

tokens.name: color.ringDark
tokens.doc: The dark ring: on the light ground it is the outermost ring (the silhouette), on the dark ground it lies inside the light one.

tokens.name: ring.outer
tokens.doc: Which ring is outermost: dark on the light ground, light on the dark ground, so the silhouette of every mark is at least 4.5:1 against what it stands on.

tokens.name: color.accent
tokens.doc: Selection, focus and the interface highlight (amber).

tokens.name: text.ink
tokens.doc: Colour of the code and name beside a mark (dark ink on the light ground, white on the dark one).

tokens.name: text.halo
tokens.doc: Colour of the halo that keeps the text legible on any ground.

tokens.name: text.haloAlpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the solid inner halo.

tokens.name: text.haloWidth
tokens.doc: Width of the halo stroke (it extends half of this around each letter).

tokens.name: text.formUnion
tokens.doc: Ink of the name of a Union formation (brigade, division, corps): the side in deep ink, so the formation tier is set apart from the units by colour and weight, not only by size.

tokens.name: text.formConfederate
tokens.doc: Ink of the name of a Confederate formation.

tokens.name: mark.r
tokens.doc: Radius of the disc of a regiment or a battery (the fill).

tokens.name: mark.rBattalion
tokens.doc: Radius of the disc of a battalion (echelon 1): a little larger.

tokens.name: ring.light
tokens.doc: Width of the light ring around a disc or a standard.

tokens.name: ring.dark
tokens.doc: Width of the dark ring around a disc or a standard (opaque).

tokens.name: glyph.size
tokens.doc: Half-size of the arm glyph (cavalry slash, artillery dot); infantry, the plain disc, has none.

tokens.name: glyph.stroke
tokens.doc: Stroke width of the arm glyph.

tokens.name: unit.shape.confederate
tokens.doc: Silhouette of a Confederate unit mark (the side is redundant in colour and shape): square or circle.

tokens.name: flag.w.brigade
tokens.doc: Width of a brigade standard.

tokens.name: flag.h.brigade
tokens.doc: Height of a brigade standard.

tokens.name: flag.w.division
tokens.doc: Width of a division standard.

tokens.name: flag.h.division
tokens.doc: Height of a division standard.

tokens.name: flag.w.corps
tokens.doc: Width of a corps standard.

tokens.name: flag.h.corps
tokens.doc: Height of a corps standard.

tokens.name: flag.w.crowd
tokens.doc: Width of the crowd mark (a tab that stands for several records).

tokens.name: flag.h.crowd
tokens.doc: Height of the crowd mark.

tokens.name: flag.notch
tokens.doc: Depth of the swallow-tail (Union) or of the point (Confederate) at the fly end of a standard.

tokens.name: flag.radius
tokens.doc: Corner radius of a standard.

tokens.name: flag.stack
tokens.doc: Offset of the tab behind the crowd mark: "this stands for several records".

tokens.name: crowd.lineDy
tokens.doc: Half the distance between the two lines of a crowd name: who on the first, what on the second.

tokens.name: bar.len
tokens.doc: Width of a chevron of a formation standard (one chevron a brigade, two a division, three a corps).

tokens.name: bar.h
tokens.doc: Stroke of a chevron.

tokens.name: bar.pitch
tokens.doc: Distance between two chevrons.

tokens.name: gap.text
tokens.doc: Space between the mark and its text.

tokens.name: pad.left
tokens.doc: Space left of the mark inside the footprint (the selection ring lives here).

tokens.name: pad.right
tokens.doc: Space right of the text inside the footprint (half of the halo).

tokens.name: pad.band
tokens.doc: Reserved band around the mark for the hover and selection rings.

tokens.name: color.fade
tokens.doc: The ground colour the fill of an old mark is tinted toward (paper on the light ground, near-black on the dark one).

tokens.name: fade.fill
tokens.doc: How far the fill of a mark at least a battle day old is mixed toward the ground colour: a pale tint of its own hue.

tokens.name: age.outline
tokens.doc: Width of the outline, in the side colour, of a mark at least a battle day old.

tokens.name: age.union
tokens.doc: Ink of the outline, the glyph and the count of an aged Union mark.

tokens.name: age.confederate
tokens.doc: Ink of the outline, the glyph and the count of an aged Confederate mark.

tokens.name: hull.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the hairlines that join the true positions of a formation (a spanning tree: no outline, no taper, no wedge).

tokens.name: hull.dot
tokens.doc: Radius of the dot at the true position of each record.

tokens.name: leader.width
tokens.doc: Width of the leader line.

tokens.name: leader.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the leader line.

tokens.name: leader.minGap
tokens.doc: A leader and a pin are drawn only when the true position is at least this far outside the mark (the selected and hovered mark always).

tokens.name: pin.r
tokens.doc: Radius of the dot at a true position (white ring and dark hairline are added).

tokens.name: place.fromZoom
tokens.doc: Zoom from which place names appear.

tokens.name: place.dot
tokens.doc: Radius of the dot of a place (a ring when the position is in doubt).

tokens.name: edge.fadePx
tokens.doc: Width of the band at every edge of the map in which a whole mark fades in or out (it is never cut in two).

tokens.name: motion.selectMs
tokens.doc: Time constant of the selection ring (it draws itself around the mark).

tokens.name: motion.hoverMs
tokens.doc: Time constant of the hover ring and of the lift.

tokens.name: motion.rippleMs
tokens.doc: Duration of the ring that leaves a mark when it arrives.
